create_roc_curve_display: create ROC curve display for a specific class using One-vs-Rest strategy with chance level
compute_roc_auc_score: compute micro-averaged and macro-averaged One-vs-Rest ROC AUC scores for multiclass classification
compute_roc_curve_points: compute ROC curve points (FPR, TPR) and area under curve for micro-averaged multiclass evaluation
binarize_multiclass_labels: binarize multiclass labels into one-hot encoding for One-vs-Rest ROC evaluation
compute_ovo_roc_curves: compute One-vs-One multiclass ROC curves for all pairwise class combinations with macro-averaging
